modules.title: Introduction to David and Solomon
modules.html:
David the shepherd boy defeats Goliath and becomes king; Solomon's wisdom, the building of the Temple, and the division of the kingdom. This section covers introduction to david and solomon.

Key points

  • David's refusal to kill Saul in the cave showed his _____. — respect for the Lord's anointed.
  • Solomon asked God for _____ to rule his people effectively. — wisdom.
  • Who was the queen that visited Solomon to test his wisdom — Queen of Sheba.
  • Solomon's temple was built in the city of _____. — Jerusalem.
  • David's sin with Bathsheba was exposed by the prophet _____. — Nathan.

Worked examples

Q: David's refusal to kill Saul in the cave showed his _____.
A: respect for the Lord's anointed — David believed that it was wrong to touch the 'Lord's anointed', regardless of Saul's behavior.

Q: Solomon asked God for _____ to rule his people effectively.
A: wisdom — At Gibeon, Solomon asked for a 'discerning heart' (wisdom) to govern the vast people of Israel.

quiz.q: David's refusal to kill Saul in the cave showed his _____.
quiz.solution: David believed that it was wrong to touch the 'Lord's anointed', regardless of Saul's behavior.

quiz.q: Solomon asked God for _____ to rule his people effectively.
quiz.solution: At Gibeon, Solomon asked for a 'discerning heart' (wisdom) to govern the vast people of Israel.

quiz.q: Who was the queen that visited Solomon to test his wisdom?
quiz.solution: The Queen of Sheba came with hard questions and was overwhelmed by Solomon's wisdom and wealth.

quiz.q: Solomon's temple was built in the city of _____.
quiz.solution: Jerusalem was the political and religious capital where the temple was situated.

quiz.q: David's sin with Bathsheba was exposed by the prophet _____.
quiz.solution: Prophet Nathan used a parable about a rich man stealing a poor man's ewe lamb to convict David of his adultery and murder.

quiz.q: The wisdom of Solomon was notably demonstrated in his judgment between _____.
options: two harlots claiming a living child
quiz.solution: Solomon proposed to divide the living child in half, knowing the real mother would prefer to give up the child than see it killed.

quiz.q: Solomon built the Temple of the Lord in the city of _____.
quiz.solution: Jerusalem was the capital and the religious center where the First Temple was constructed.
